## Incident Overview
Scenario: All reviewer agents fail with ContextWindowExceededError.
Expected: llm-review exits non-zero, blocks PR.
Actual: exits 0. WARNING logged but ignored.
Observed in CI run 25538276056: 5 agents produced only synthetic fallback_exhausted findings, scores: {}, summary: ''.
Files: plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py and runner script.
data.title: [llm-review CI]: All reviewer agents hit ContextWindowExceededError -> exit 0 despite no valid review
